id: title:Gilbert09:retry a dropped connection before reporting the fanout reuse flag check

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion availability and transient failure recovery
review.reason: Adds a retry wrapper around the Team database lookup and a second-exception handler for persistent failures, with a test asserting recovery from transient drops. This establishes a bounded improvement in warehouse ingestion reliability by distinguishing transient connection drops from persistent failures, though exact retry parameters and complete execution paths are not shown.
review.uncertainty: Exact retry parameters and complete warehouse ingestion execution path are not demonstrated; tier relies on the presence of the retry wrapper and exception handling rather than full systemic implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the `retry_on_db_connection_drop` utility or the configuration of the retry behavior, so the exact retry parameters and failure handling are not demonstrated. The chunk also does not show the complete execution path of the warehouse ingestion, so the broader systemic impact is not established.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional retry wrapper around the Team database lookup, wrapping the ORM call with a retry utility and adding a second-exception handler.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion gate checks team existence; transient connection drops are retried while persistent failures are treated as degraded DB and reported.

observations.behavior: Adds a second-exception handler for persistent database failures after the retry, capturing the exception and returning False.
observations.posthog_connection: Persistent database connection failures are reported and treated as degraded, preventing warehouse ingestion while transient drops are recovered.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that a transient database connection drop followed by success does not report an exception.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion gate recovery: transient connection drops are recovered and do not block ingestion.
